post_content: This 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari combines elephants under Kilimanjaro, Lake Naivasha, Lake Nakuru and the Masai Mara on a private road safari from Nairobi.
overview:
This 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari is a private road safari from Nairobi that also visits Lake Naivasha and Lake Nakuru. You stay 2 nights at Amboseli Sopa Lodge, 1 night at Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge and 2 nights at PrideInn Mara Camp, on full board. The best season is July to September, during the Great Migration, and the price is on request.

It suits first-time visitors, couples and families who want Kenya's classic parks in under a week, with a private 4x4 Land Cruiser and an English or bilingual driver guide.

Why choose a 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari?

Amboseli and the Masai Mara are Kenya's two best-known parks, and they are very different. Amboseli is famous for big elephant herds with Mount Kilimanjaro behind them, while the Masai Mara has lions, cheetahs, leopards and, from July to September, the wildebeest and zebra herds of the Great Migration.

The route between them passes the Great Rift Valley and two lakes, so you add a boat safari and a rhino park without extra travel days.

  • First-time visitors: four parks and lakes in six days.
  • Short holidays: back in Nairobi in time for an evening flight on day 6.
  • Families: a private vehicle and a pace that suits you.

What to expect on the 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari

Day 1 starts with a meet-and-greet in Nairobi and a drive of about 4 hours to Amboseli National Park, arriving for lunch and an afternoon game drive. Day 2 is a full day in Amboseli for elephants, views of Mount Kilimanjaro and Observation Hill, which looks out over the whole park.

On day 3 you drive about 5 hours to Lake Naivasha with a Rift Valley viewpoint stop, take a boat safari and a nature walk on Crescent Island, then continue to Lake Nakuru. Day 4 begins with a morning game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park for rhinos, giraffes, lions and flamingos, then a drive of about 5 hours to the Masai Mara.

Day 5 is a full day in the Masai Mara National Reserve with a picnic lunch on the plains, and an optional hot air balloon safari at sunrise. On day 6 you visit a Maasai village and drive about 5 hours back to Nairobi for your flight.

Is 6 days enough for Amboseli and the Masai Mara?

Yes, 6 days is enough for a full day in each of Amboseli and the Masai Mara, plus the two lakes. If you want more time at the Mara River during the migration, our 7 day Masai Mara river crossing safari adds a third night in the Mara. Read our best time to visit the Masai Mara guide to plan your dates.

What is included in this Kenya safari package?

The package includes a private 4WD Land Cruiser, 5 nights of accommodation, all park entry and conservation fees, full board meals, an English or bilingual driver guide, unlimited game drives on the itinerary and drinking water. The Lake Naivasha boat ride and Maasai village visit are included at no extra cost.

Not included are the hot air balloon safari over the Masai Mara (USD 500 per person), travel insurance, visas, international flights, tips (about USD 10 per person per day is suggested), drinks and personal items. For more on Amboseli, see our guide to Amboseli National Park attractions, and see what affects the price in our Kenya safari cost guide.

How much does the 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari cost?

Price on request. The cost depends on your travel dates, group size, the season and the lodges available, so we prepare every quote personally rather than showing one fixed price.

faq.q: When is the best time for a 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari?
faq.a: The best time for a 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari is July to September, when the Great Migration herds are usually in the Masai Mara and the weather is dry. Amboseli is good all year, and the clearest views of Mount Kilimanjaro are usually early in the morning.

faq.q: What is included in the 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari?
faq.a: The safari includes a private 4WD Land Cruiser with a driver guide, 5 nights on full board, all park and conservation fees, unlimited game drives on the itinerary, drinking water, a Lake Naivasha boat ride and a Maasai village visit. Flights, visas, insurance, tips, drinks and the balloon safari are extra.

faq.q: Which lodges are used on this Amboseli and Masai Mara safari?
faq.a: This Amboseli and Masai Mara safari uses Amboseli Sopa Lodge for 2 nights, Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge for 1 night and PrideInn Mara Camp for 2 nights. If a lodge is full for your dates, we offer a similar lodge and confirm it in your quote.

faq.q: Is the 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari good for families?
faq.a: Yes, the 6 day Amboseli and Masai Mara safari works well for families because you travel in a private vehicle and can set the pace. Some drives take about 5 hours, so tell us your children's ages and we will plan stops and rooms around them.

faq.a: To book, send the enquiry form on this page, WhatsApp us on +254 706 223888 or email bookings@divulgeadventures.com with your dates and group size. We reply with a written quote and lodge availability. For July to September, book a few months ahead.
